title: MOOR Ultra Funnel Law — Secure Core / Elastic Society
intent: Build the most secure, premium, inspectable and expansible practical Funnel law: a minimal deterministic authority core capable of governing an arbitrarily large recursive society of Funnel cases, solver workers, packages, child Funnels, verifiers and learning systems. Scale must be constrained by explicit resource budgets and physical infrastructure rather than fixed topology.
laws: Page 0 is immutable, content-addressed and inherited by reference rather than rewritten.
Authority and intelligence are separate: workers propose; law decides state transitions.
Every authority-bearing state transition produces or consumes a typed receipt.
Every child Funnel is scoped by parent question, capabilities, dependencies and a conserved budget envelope.
Synthetic solver consensus, literal Sebastian evidence and execution verification are separate confidence channels.
Independent solver agreement may deliberately manufacture synthetic decision confidence, but never owner evidence.
No worker, package, UI or child case can self-declare verified, promoted or authoritative.
Corrections and relevant dependency changes stale affected downstream receipts.
Scale occurs outside the kernel; authority returns through receipt verification.
Unknown integrity fails closed for the affected authority action while unrelated branches continue.
Resource pressure creates backpressure and warnings, not hidden truncation or semantic substitution.
Package reuse requires content identity plus compatible scope and emits a reuse receipt.
Historical authority evidence is append-only; disposable work may be compacted according to policy.
Execution success and intent satisfaction are separately verified.
Production law promotion is explicit, versioned, regression-tested and reversible to a prior verified law version.

Grounded readiness: include our own ordinary fallibility in the diagnosis, state inconvenient reality before comfort, convert optimism into preparation before opportunity, and allow meaningful commitment only inside explicit cost, reciprocity/agency and stop-condition boundaries.

planes.title: Reasoning Society
planes.property: Wide, replaceable, horizontally scalable, no direct authority.

planes.title: Pulse / Foundry Plane
planes.property: Everything is visible, editable as draft, and traceable to source.

recursion.rule: Any material unresolved question can spawn child FunnelCases.
recursion.childOutput: Typed ChildFunnelReceipt with verdict, confidence channels, open risks and hashes.
recursion.scaling: Limits are configuration/budget defaults rather than topology constants.

verification.source: tests, runtime behavior and acceptance checks

confidence.rule: Never collapse the three channels into one unlabeled confidence number.

consensus.isolation: Workers submit before seeing peer ballots.
consensus.normalization: Comparable propositions are produced before voting.
consensus.independence: Correlation between models/seeds/harnesses reduces effective independence.
consensus.dissent: Minority alternatives are retained when material.
consensus.escalation: Tie, low confidence, owner-only decision or unresolved contradiction may spawn children or reach Sebastian.

budgets.conservation: Child allocations subtract from the parent envelope unless explicit policy/owner authority expands it.
budgets.backpressure: When a budget is exhausted, the affected branch returns BUDGET_EXHAUSTED instead of silently lowering quality.
budgets.forecast: Foundry must show projected resource use before Reassemble and Run.

packages.rule: A package is instantiated as data/config; source logic is not duplicated per instance.
packages.reuse: Verified package outputs may be cached only when compatibility/scope predicates pass.

persistence.hot: Active cases, current receipts, budgets and dependencies.
persistence.warm: Recent full traces, ballots, failures and architecture experiments.
persistence.cold: Compacted authority chain, verified summaries, representative dissent/failures and audit roots.
persistence.privacy: Raw personal Page 0/evidence is local-first or encrypted/private; code and generic law packages may remain in the repo.

promotion.rollback: Previous verified law versions remain addressable and restorable.

pulse.rule: All Funnel Fabric information is discoverable from Project Pulse.

acceptance: A real sealed Funnel kernel run approves this amalgamated blueprint and produces a verifiable receipt.
Authority-bearing receipts are typed and content-addressed.
Page 0, owner evidence and ledger history cannot be silently rewritten through public APIs.
Child cases receive scoped capabilities and conserved budgets.
Independent solver ballots can raise solver confidence without altering owner confidence.
Arbitrary package/child multiplicity is configuration-driven within budget limits.
Budget exhaustion is explicit rather than silently degrading semantics.
Receipt staleness detects relevant correction/dependency/law changes.
Promotion is separately gated and regression-tested.
All blueprint/law/test/receipt assets are indexed in Pulse under the Funnel Fabric project.
The existing v44 Funnel and Harness anti-bypass behavior remains compatible until explicit promotion.

groundedReadiness.rule: See reality clearly, include ourselves in the failure model, prepare before opportunity, and preserve enough openness to act decisively when a worthwhile exception appears.
guardrails: Optimism is readiness, not a probability claim.
Sacrifice requires a bounded cost budget and explicit stop condition.
Where reciprocity matters, the other party retains agency and contributes evidence of reciprocal movement.
The principle never overrides factual evidence, safety, or the existing authority boundary.
